Moderator: 
Ladies and gentlemen, good day, and welcome to the Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd 
Conference Call. As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode and there 
will be an opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation concludes. Should you need 
assistance during this conference call, please signal an operator by pressing star then zero on 
your touch-tone phone. Please note that this conference is being recorded.  
 
Today on the call, we have with us Mr. Anurag Choudhary, CMD and CEO; and Mr. Somesh 
Satnalika, EVP, Tyre and Strategy. 
 
Before we proceed with the call, I would like to give you a disclaimer that this conference call 
may contain forward-looking statements about the company, which are based on the beliefs, 
opinions, and expectations as of today. Actual results may differ materially. The statements are 
not the guarantee of the future performance and involve risks and uncertainties that are difficult 
to predict. A detailed Safe Harbor statement is being given on Page number 2 of the Investors 
presentation of the company, which have been uploaded on the Stock Exchanges and on the 
company’s website. 
 
I now hand the conference over to Mr. Anurag Choudhary. Thank you, and over to you, sir. 
Anurag Choudhary: 
Thank you. Good evening, everyone, and thank you for joining us today. We deeply value your 
continued trust, confidence and engagement with Himadri. Q2 FY27 was another important 
quarter in Himadri's transformation journey. Several initiatives we have spoken about over the 
past several quarters are now translating from research to qualification, from capacity creation 
to customer engagement, and from strategic intent towards commercialisation. 
 
Before discussing these developments in detail, let me briefly touch upon our financial 
performance for the period ended 30th September 2026. For H1 FY27 on a consolidated basis, 
revenue surpassed INR 3,000 crores, EBITDA exceeded INR 600 crores and profit after tax 
crossed INR 450 crores. This performance reflects the strength of our business, an optimised 
product mix, operational efficiencies, and our continued focus on value-added products. 
 
Over the years, we have invested consistently in research and development, process engineering, 
manufacturing capabilities, customer relationships, and strategic partnerships. These 
investments are increasingly expanding our addressable markets, strengthening our competitive 
position and creating the foundation for next phase of Himadri's growth. 
 
Let me begin with the area where this transformation is perhaps most visible: speciality and 
advanced materials.  
Across our new material platforms, our focus remains clear: develop differentiated technologies, 
validate them rigorously with customers, and scale them in a disciplined manner. 
 
Our 200 TPA Carbon Nanotube facility remains targeted for commissioning in Q4 FY27. 
Carbon Nanotubes represent an important next-generation material with applications across 
lithium-ion batteries, semiconductors, electronics, conductive applications, and other high-
performance uses. 

October 22, 2026                                     Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd 
 
Page 3 of 18 
 
 
In Super Speciality Carbon Black, our planned 6,000 TPA capacity remains targeted for Q4 
FY28. This represents the next step in our journey from speciality carbon black to super 
speciality grades, towards highly engineered niche products designed for demanding 
applications. 
 
Our LFP cathode active materials roadmap is also progressing well with the initial 2,000 TPA 
capacity targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27. The initial capacity is designed to support 
customer qualification and early commercial engagements, while also establishing the 
foundation for a significantly large scale-up opportunity. The progress in customer engagements 
together with strong visibility on future demand gives us confidence to move into the next phase 
of expansion with 40,000 TPA capacity planned for commissioning next year. 
 
On the anode side, our capabilities continue to progress across synthetic graphite and next-
generation silicon carbon technologies, strengthening our objectives of building a 
comprehensive battery materials portfolio. We have already provided materials to leading 
domestic and global customers for their qualification process. Customers' feedback and 
engagements have been very encouraging. 
 
In anthraquinone and carbazole, our in-house engineering team has enabled us to accelerate 
execution with full capacity 5,300 TPA now targeted for commissioning together in Q4 FY27. 
The reason we are doing 2 phases together is there, that so in order to avoid any shutdown of 3 
months during the commissioning of Phase 2. This allows us to bring the entire capacity to 
market in one shot, enabling faster market penetration and market share gains. As you all are 
aware, these expansions are focused largely on very high value-add categories and are therefore 
expected to have meaningful impact on company's profitability and margins. 
 
Importantly, let me inform you, all these developments are increasingly being complemented by 
deeper and more frequent customer engagements. During the quarter, we have entered into 
NDAs with Indian and international customers across Battery Materials, Carbon Nanotube 
(CNT) and Super Speciality Carbon Black segments. Our ENERGEX speciality carbon black 
grades received approval for high-voltage cable and battery applications followed by 
commercial orders. 
 
For us, this progression from research to qualification to customer relationship and commercial 
adoption thereafter is particularly important. It validates both the technology and the market 
opportunity. We continue to build ecosystem across lithium-ion battery value chain through our 
strategic investments and partnerships with a focus extending from material innovation and 
technology development to cell-level validation and eventual commercial deployments. 
 
During the quarter, we invested further in Sicona Battery Technologies. Sicona has also 
completed the acquisition of 100% of Advano in United States, adding valuable silicon anode 
intellectual property, a U.S.-based pilot plant facility and additional R&D and cell-testing 
capabilities.  
Further strengthening its commercialisation road map, Sicona has secured AUD45 million in 
funding from Australian Renewable Energy Agency (ARENA) to advance its next-generation 

October 22, 2026                                     Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd 
 
Page 4 of 18 
 
silicon carbon anode technology. These developments add significant technological and 
execution depth to the platform and reinforce our conviction in silicon carbon as an important 
next-generation anode technology. 
 
Our strategic investment in International Battery Company (IBC) further complements this 
ecosystem in a unique way. Through IBC, Himadri has access to a platform that bridges material 
innovation, cell-level validation and commercial deployment, providing us with a strategic 
advantage as we strengthen our presence across the lithium-ion value chain.  
Together, Sicona, IBC, and our in-house capabilities are creating a collaborative innovation 
ecosystem that spans material science, technology development, validation, and application. 
This gives us a differentiated position as the lithium-ion battery value chain continues to evolve. 
 
As our portfolio becomes increasingly sophisticated and global, our commercial architecture 
must evolve alongside it.  
During the quarter, we incorporated Ardent Impex FZCO in Dubai Airport Free Zone Area as a 
wholly owned subsidiary. This provides a dedicated platform for global sales, marketing, 
strategic trading, and procurement, thereby enhancing our proximity to customers and suppliers 
across Middle East, Africa, and Europe.  
Simply put, as Himadri becomes more global in what it develops and manufactures, we must 
also become more global in how we reach markets. 
 
Global supply chain realignment is also creating a significant opportunity for India. Building 
domestic capabilities in advanced materials can reduce import dependence while creating global 
competitive manufacturing platforms. Our investments across CNT, Super Speciality Carbon 
Black, LFP, synthetic anodes, and silicon carbon technologies align closely with this opportunity 
and with the larger vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat. 
 
Another significant development during the quarter was the proposed merger of Birla Tyres 
business with Himadri.  
Following the acquisition of Birla Tyres in October '23, we focused on restoring operations, 
modernising the manufacturing infrastructure, upgrading equipment, rebuilding the distribution 
network, and refreshing the product portfolio. Commercial production resumed on 29th May 
2025, and since then, the business has steadily strengthened into operating foundation and 
market presence. 
 
The Board has proposed the demerger of tyre business from Dalmia Bharat Refractories Limited 
into Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd , subject to the requisite statutory, regulatory, creditor, 
and shareholders' approvals.  
Strategically, the proposed transaction brings together complementary capabilities across 
feedstock, speciality carbon black, R&D, manufacturing, and finished tyre production. 

October 22, 2026                                     Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd 
 
Page 5 of 18 
 
 
Direct ownership should enable closer alignment across capacity utilisation, modernisation, 
capital allocation, and product development. More importantly, it creates opportunity to bring 
our understanding of carbon material closer to tyre engineering, particularly in a specialised 
application where material performance can play meaningful differentiation. We, therefore, see 
this as a natural next phase in the journey of Birla Tyres and an important step towards building 
a more integrated and scalable mobility platform. 
 
As we enter the second half of FY27, our priorities are clear: We'll continue to strengthen our 
core business, accelerate customer qualification, commercialisation across new material 
platforms, expand international presence, and progress the proposed merger of Birla Tyres.  
We remain confident in achieving our previously guided target of INR 1,100 crores plus PAT 
by FY28. This will be supported by the sustained performance of our core business and 
commissioning of new capacities over the coming periods. 
 
Our philosophy remains unchanged: invest patiently in science, execute with discipline, and 
scale when the technology and the market are ready.  
I would like to thank every member of Himadri family, our customers, business partners, 
shareholders, and stakeholders for their continued trust and support. 
 
With that, I'll now hand over the discussion to Mr. Somesh Satnalika for further details on 
financial performance and business outlook. We look forward for your questions to an engaging 
discussion. Thank you. 
Somesh Satnalika: 
Thank you, Anuragji, and good evening, everyone. Now let me take you through the key 
financial highlights for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. On a standalone 
basis, our revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 stood at INR 1,543 crores compared to INR 
1,070 crores in Q2 FY26. EBITDA for the quarter came in at INR 308 crores, a growth of 27% 
year-on-year compared with INR 243 crores in Q2 FY26. PAT stood at INR 240 crores, 
reflecting a 28% increase year-on-year compared to INR 187 crores in the same quarter last year. 
 
For the first half year of FY27, revenue stood at INR 2,817 crores while EBITDA reached INR 
610 crores, up 28% year-on-year from INR 477 crores in first half of FY26. Profit after tax for 
the half year stood at INR 463 crores, up 25% year-on-year over INR 369 crores reported in H1 
FY26. 
 
On a consolidated basis, revenue for Q2 FY27 stood at INR 1,691 crores versus INR 1,071 crores 
in the same period last year. EBITDA for Q2 FY27 stood at INR 303 crores, recording a growth 
of 27% year-on-year and PAT at INR 231 crores with a growth of 31% year-on-year.  
 
Our half year revenue stood at INR 3,123 crores, EBITDA at INR 616 crores, PAT at INR 460 
crores, reflecting strong performance across all business segments. We continue to maintain a 
healthy liquidity position with a comfortable leverage profile. That is all from our side. We will 
now open the line for questions and answers. Thank you.
